column3: English agent note: splits the tool registry (host plane) from its per-scope projection; ToolRuntime.presentAs(mode) writes one cell on the calling scope's ToolLayer via ScopedLayers.effect, and run_code is appended per scope with the reserved name now unconditional.

Chinese translation of the same note (title 按 agent 的工具呈现方式); keeps the same 问题/决策/考虑过的替代方案/后果 sections and reproduces the three-rejection list including the gen-tool-catalog gate on the tool-* prefix.
Bilingual pairing record: pins git blob a41541a8 for the English note and c0e4fe0d for the Chinese one, with the verify-translation-pairing --write command as the re-record step.

English agent note: dsh-tool-pwsh's presentResult now mirrors dsh-tool-bash call-for-call; parseExitStatus/ParsedExitStatus moved into @deepseek-ai/dsh-shell so one inverse can never drift between the twins.

Chinese translation; title kept in English, headings partly untranslated (Problem/Decision/Alternatives considered/Consequences) while the body is fully Chinese, so the translation is not section-name-consistent with its siblings.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 784b80cc (English) and 49ab20a9 (Chinese) as the last confirmed-consistent state.
English agent note: the empty hero always renders a localized Preview/预览版 badge with no config switch, on the business-tertiary background with the theme's primary label token for 4.5:1 contrast.
Chinese translation (Web 预览版产品徽标); reproduces the three rejected alternatives (configurable preview, business-primary text, hiding from the a11y tree) and the removal-trigger rule.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 3984c284 (English) and 5154e2f9 (Chinese).

English agent note: the private ctx.agentTeams service owns generated agentTeams/view|createTask|updateTask Remote methods, and the experimental client-ui package mounts them through the stable ctx.remote without adding Team contracts to stable packages.
Chinese translation (实验性 Agent Teams Web 控件); keeps the 边界 section that lists what the Web UI deliberately does not do (no mailbox timeline, worktree or Git controls, no teammate creation/deletion).
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 2909736d (English) and de85e947 (Chinese).

English agent note: @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-badge registers one immutable bundled skill provider on ctx.skills at the bundled rank (after project, custom and user sources) so a user-owned dsh-badge can override it; the shipped CLI row is disabled by default.
Chinese translation (内置 dsh 徽章 skill); reproduces the single rejected alternative (mounting packaged files through dsh-skill-filesystem) and the provider-lifecycle consequence.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob fcd06310 (English) and 873c35b9 (Chinese).

English agent note: ctx.subagents.interrupt(targetSessionId, authority) cancels only the live target's current turn via Agent.cancel(cause, { keepInbox: true }) and returns void; authority is a closed {kind:'user'|'ancestor'} union, and an absent target is an accepted no-op.
Chinese translation (Continuable subagent 当前轮次中断); carries the two authority variants verbatim and the parked-queue rule that an interrupt never auto-starts the next queued follow-up.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 30438dcc (English) and 22cd140c (Chinese).

English agent note: the continuation manager delivers the settlement notice itself from inside the disposal transaction; the send happens before releaseOwnership, a resident parent receives it via its private SubagentInbox, and epochStopReason() reads the epoch's own log rather than live state.
Chinese translation; the H1 title is kept in English while the whole body is Chinese, and the two ordering rules are preserved with their full failure-mode prose.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 3843d727 (English) and fe030c06 (Chinese).

English agent note: a per-instance connection supervisor owns client/transport generations, an isCurrent fence makes stale generations inert, one queue serializes every syncTools call, and a bounded backoff shares an outage budget that resets only after a connection survives the stability window.
Chinese translation; the H1 title is kept in English, and the six bolded decision paragraphs (触发条件/代隔离/有界退避/配置与解析/可观测状态/资源释放) are reproduced in full.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 35b3fa2e (English) and 5617be70 (Chinese).

English agent note: the ui-layout ThemePresenter owns one <meta name=theme-color> node and writes the body's computed background into it after applying a resolved snapshot; the PWA manifest carries no static theme_color.
Chinese translation (基于解析后主题的颜色元数据); reproduces the three rejected alternatives (manifest theme_color, prefers-color-scheme media queries, a per-ThemeDefinition themeColor field).
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 3fa09b4e (English) and 42e2d9ca (Chinese).

English agent note: SessionManager owns an in-memory completion-reminder set; a running-to-idle edge of a non-selected session arms it, and the sidebar renders the existing StateDot 'done' state, giving three disjoint signals (green finished / amber awaiting input / blue running).
Chinese translation (侧边栏会话完成提醒点); the section headings stay in English (Problem/Decision/Consequences/Alternatives considered) while the body is Chinese.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob dea7dcaf (English) and 0052b399 (Chinese).
English agent note: the Web entry links /manifest.webmanifest with id/start_url/scope at / and display fullscreen, and deliberately omits lang, theme_color, background_color and any service worker.
Chinese translation (Web 安装 manifest 元数据); reproduces the five rejected alternatives including the explicit refusal of a partial offline contract.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 3589c01e (English) and 65d62b69 (Chinese).

English agent note: empty-draft Cmd/Ctrl+Enter steers every still-pending queued row into the running turn via the same session.updateQueue(itemId, {kind:'steer'}) the per-row button uses, applied sequentially so FIFO is guaranteed at the host.
Chinese translation (空输入时 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 将 Web 排队消息全部插话); keeps the five rejected alternatives and the note that the client gate is advisory while the host stays authoritative.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 69550d5a (English) and c0e9c3ab (Chinese).

English agent note: ui-skill registers a component under ui-tool's tool.call.toolview slot keyed 'skill', deriving every visible value from the paired call/result slice and never joining the current skill catalog.
Chinese translation (Web skill 工具行); reproduces the three rejected alternatives and the note that a result-only history page intentionally stays on the generic fallback.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 5fa14b8e (English) and ea5f8d93 (Chinese).

English agent note: ctx.agentDefaultModel provides the shared default, saveSelection() writes the complete user section so an omitted reasoningEffort clears a stored one, and session.prompt refuses with model-unavailable when no adapter serves the selected provider.
Chinese translation (默认模型跟随选择器); the Alternatives table is reproduced as a two-column 中文 table, and the headings use 决定/影响/无法发送消息的会话.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 82cc7727 (English) and 266a87c8 (Chinese).

English agent note: the telemetry seam owns a backend-independent SessionTelemetrySharingStatus and the /feedback handler appends one sharing sentence to the acknowledgement, read via ctx.get('telemetry') so the command works with no telemetry mounted.
Chinese translation (反馈确认中的会话共享披露); reproduces the three rejected alternatives and the note that the disclosure claims nothing about delivery or retention.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob a742d7eb (English) and 8c6ac474 (Chinese).

English agent note: producedFileMentions resolves an inline-code token by exact path or by being the basename of exactly one produced path; ui-deliverables registers a static ui:deliverable-file-references prompt section so the renderer and the guidance have one owner.
Chinese translation (行内代码文件提及可打开其命名的文件); reproduces the six rejected alternatives and the note that a mention link can never 404.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 023cbe09 (English) and 6b84885b (Chinese).

English agent note: while no Workspace owns the new Session the whole composer card activates the existing conversation.hero.workspace picker, with the click on pointerdown so the picker's outside-close cannot race a reopen.
Chinese translation (未选择 Workspace 时从编辑器打开现有选择器); reproduces the three rejected alternatives and the consequence that the same DOM node becomes the editable composer.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob ce9cff96 (English) and 0484c069 (Chinese).

English agent note: 'dsh run [--profile <name>] [--patch <path>...] <task...>' is the one-shot headless grammar; the note is marked superseded by the app-owned command-line decision but its direct-execution contract remains.
Chinese translation (dsh run 负责一次性 headless 执行); the alternatives are reproduced as a two-column Chinese table and the superseded-grammar banner is kept.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 8cd6b918 (English) and fd8ff996 (Chinese).

English agent note: PiAiModelProfile gains reasoningEfforts where each key is a level the selector offers and its value the spelling dispatch sends; 'off' is a three-state key, and modelOverrides reshapes individual catalog models without replacing the served set.
Chinese translation (llm-pi-ai 的按模型推理声明); reproduces the four rejected alternatives including the 66-of-1230 non-identity map-entry count.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 65ef9a2d (English) and 2b86d590 (Chinese).

English agent note: dsh-tool-skill registers a second agent/pre-step listener that scans the step's claimed user-source messages for whitespace-bounded /name tokens, resolves them against the user-invocable skill directory and appends the injection after every other injection of the step.
Chinese translation (pre-step 手势边界上的用户显式 skill 调用); reproduces the six rejected alternatives and the accepted residual that a workspace of only user-only skills may publish no catalog.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 48bc73d9 (English) and 7222711f (Chinese).

English agent note: task state reaches the browser as one whole-snapshot control frame per session, with four carrier rules (never resume, fan out unowned changes, stay optional, represent emptiness explicitly) and an explicit rule that no web path may call ctx.jobs.read().
Chinese translation (Web 后台任务展示); the 141-line English note is reproduced in full, including the 605-line SubagentCatalogAction rejection and the tsconfig paths-entry consequence.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob c252f939 (English) and 575d5bab (Chinese).

English agent note: dsh-tool-subagent declares isConcurrencySafe: () => true for every call form, so sibling delegations in one assistant step overlap under the loop's rolling pool up to maxParallelToolCalls with results still committed in model order.
Chinese translation (并行 subagent 委派); reproduces the four rejected alternatives and the note that only interchangeable twin delegations replay deterministically.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob c54222cc (English) and 4ca38a37 (Chinese).

English agent note: the capture/append pair for delegated policy overrides moved into dsh-subagent/src/child-agent.ts; startContinuable captures before its first await, and a cold resume appends nothing because the durable child log IS the state.
Chinese translation (可继续 subagent 策略继承——持久化子日志拥有委派时快照); reproduces the four rejected alternatives including re-capturing on cold resume.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 2954bb9d (English) and 4f818b3a (Chinese).

English agent note: a pick staged from another screen carries a one-shot introduce flag through the seat store; the reveal stagger is capped twice, 40ms per tick and one shared 200ms window, so duration is a property of the cue rather than the locale.
Chinese translation (创造模式引导以介绍动效落在预设 chip 上); reproduces the three rejected alternatives and the CSS/component coupling note.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob a49cb75e (English) and 753e0223 (Chinese).

English agent note: dsh-tool-workflow projects every top-level accepted run into the calling Agent's Session as four durable events; recording is observational, a first failed append disables later writes, and a package invariant rejects duplicate run starts and updates after a run ending.
Chinese translation (Chat 中的持久工作流运行); reproduces the four rejected alternatives including the durable-projection and wire-channel refusals.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 52476b9d (English) and 936197b8 (Chinese).

English agent note: read_image lives in dsh-tool-fs over existing extension points; FileSystem.readBytes(target, signal, maxBytes) puts the byte bound at the seam, registration is composition-conditional under ctx.inject(['attachments']) and execution is route-gated on inputModalities.
Chinese translation (基于既有 seam 的最小 read_image 工具); reproduces the four rejected alternatives including the magic-byte-sniffing refusal.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 7c91b65c (English) and ba280ed8 (Chinese).

English agent note: a delegated child runs with approvalPolicy 'never' whenever the approval capability is composed, enforced by the existing ApprovalService 'never' semantics, and every in-process child is told so via a scoped subagent:delegation runtime-context statement.
Chinese translation (被委派的 subagent 以钉定为 'never' 的审批策略运行); reproduces the four rejected alternatives and the note that children persisted before the pin fold to the deployment default.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 56d356f6 (English) and 1033758a (Chinese).

English agent note: both telemetry feeds use DSH_TELEMETRY_MODE as positive consent; the dsh-sdk launcher freezes consent from the launching environment before the command runs, because a project .env could otherwise grant reporting of its own configuration.
Chinese translation (遥测必须显式启用); reproduces the four rejected alternatives and the explicit-refusal-over-throw rule at the launcher boundary.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 38d682cf (English) and 7bb406ce (Chinese).

English agent note: three host-plane plugins register their own settings namespace and one browser-side Plugins section aggregates feature-owned tabs; a card stages its edits and writes them on Save, and the provider reads options through a source thunk snapshot at each operation's entry.

Chinese translation; the H1 title is kept in English while the body is Chinese, and the eight rejected alternatives are reproduced, including the per-property-options-thunk bug that sent an old key to a new endpoint.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 40b23fe2 (English) and d0937ba4 (Chinese).

English agent note: GET /api/session.export streams one host-compressed ZIP attachment with no manifest; the exporter crosses the authoritative SessionStore.flush barrier before each read and the browser never buffers the archive.
Chinese translation (Web 会话日志导出——宿主流式 ZIP 下载); reproduces the four rejected alternatives including the client-side jszip path.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob b71fe00a (English) and d1aa651f (Chinese).

English agent note: tool-subagent resolves an omitted run_in_background from the lifecycle policy, so backgroundMode continuable means omission is background; a tool:<toolName> system-prompt section renders only while that tool remains visible in the assembly scope.
Chinese translation (可继续委派采用后台优先); reproduces the five rejected alternatives and the accepted overlap of a child handoff with the manager settlement notice.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 566ffdd6 (English) and f8acd560 (Chinese).

English agent note: an unreported completion picks its lane from what the owner is doing (busy owner is injected, idle owner is woken with followup), the maxConsecutiveWakes cap is restored by claiming a user message rather than by arrival, and completion is announced last.
Chinese translation; the H1 title is kept in English, and the four decision sub-headings (繁忙的所有者保留注入/连续唤醒上限/销毁自行认领报告/完成是最后才宣布的) are preserved.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 08e87b0d (English) and fd3b838f (Chinese).

English agent note: a minimize/maximize toggle on the ask-user question card header; state lives in QuestionFlow local state so drafts and the current question index survive collapse, and the collapsed body is unmounted so no hidden interactive surface remains.
Chinese translation (可收起的提问卡片); the section headings stay in English while the body is Chinese.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 8d77ee9b (English) and e0fcc74d (Chinese).

English agent note: dsh-llm-deepseek sends x-deepseek-harness-user-id after successful credential resolution; the identity is transport metadata and must not enter the request body, prompt, token accounting, KV-cache identity or session log.
Chinese translation (DeepSeek 请求用户与会话身份头部); the rejected-alternatives table is reproduced as a two-column Chinese table.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob d82256d0 (English) and 794e5768 (Chinese).

English agent note: AssistantMessageNode gains an optional messageId, ui-conversation declares a conversation.chat.assistant-actions slot, and a per-Session MessageFeedbackController sends the last observed version as ifVersion with null meaning must-not-exist.
Chinese translation (消息反馈的 Web 界面); reproduces the four rejected alternatives and the note that the conflict reply itself carries the authoritative current item.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob ec391dc7 (English) and 060e38e2 (Chinese).
English agent note: minimal profiles expose persistent bash (pwsh on Windows) and mount no context-compaction or filesystem provider, so minimal sessions never summarize or replace earlier history.
Chinese translation (minimal profile 使用裸运行时); reproduces the four rejected alternatives including keeping compaction-basic mounted with a high threshold.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob a9fd9436 (English) and f2d550f6 (Chinese).

English agent note: attachment display moves into @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-attachment as pure-props atoms; both overlays body-portal so the lightbox and the transient Toast cover the viewport from every opener.
Chinese translation (Web 附件展示经附件原子组件对齐 DeepSeek Chat); reproduces the four rejected alternatives and the slot-declaration cost.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob aba9048f (English) and be4a3a53 (Chinese).

English agent note: the Web-only /export command and the 111x32 Session log capsule both drive the browser's native download manager for the same GET /api/session.export ZIP, with a HEAD preflight for preparation errors.
Chinese translation (Web /export 共用流式 Session ZIP 下载); the section headings stay in English while the body is Chinese.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 725fd954 (English) and 4e2256ab (Chinese).

English agent note: WorkflowRunPanel owns one local disclosure state for the run and a map keyed by phase; a clean-to-activity transition opens the phase and the outer run once, and normal completion checks whether focus is inside the content before closing.
Chinese translation (工作流运行的状态驱动 disclosure); reproduces the four rejected alternatives including persisting an activity epoch.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob c83f839f (English) and f0798445 (Chinese).

English agent note: a durable workspaceIds order with insertBefore semantics, a bounded five-row fold plus a provisional blank New Session row, and browser-local per-account view order that never rewrites the durable manual account.
Chinese translation (Workspace 侧边栏顺序与折叠); reproduces the six rejected alternatives including numeric drop indices and header-only hit testing.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 60bcb082 (English) and d051bae8 (Chinese).

English agent note: the hero fish hover swim is a real SMIL <animate attributeName="d"> curve deformation generated programmatically with smoothstep falloff weights, gated by a prefers-reduced-motion matchMedia state.
Chinese translation (主页鲸鱼 hover 游动变形); reproduces the three rejected alternatives and the note that the morph targets are baked constants needing regeneration if the logo path changes.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 869b0deb (English) and 64997cd0 (Chinese).

English agent note: dsh web waits for the complete Loader tree to settle and confirms webServer is live before printing the URL and handing the loopback URL to the OS browser; a scrubbed child environment keeps harness credentials away from the launcher.
Chinese translation (dsh web 打开已就绪页面); the section headings stay in English while the body is Chinese.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 4138d50c (English) and 4984be82 (Chinese).

English agent note: product one-shot subagents reuse the generic background Job runtime, so background registration and settlement stay in the existing one-shot adapter and the decision adds no provider config, event, wire field or persistence format.
Chinese translation (产品 one-shot subagent 使用通用后台 Job); the ownership table is reproduced as a four-column Chinese table.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 516a4922 (English) and db3485fd (Chinese).

English agent note: whole-page image drop via a pointer-inert body-portaled DropOverlay, and client-side intake pre-checks against the imageLimits session projection registered by apiproxy rather than the attachment service definition.
Chinese translation (整页图片拖放、上限投影预检与缩略图平铺); reproduces the four rejected alternatives including the dependency-cycle refusal.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 33f4d914 (English) and 9baaec3e (Chinese).

Chinese translation (共用弹窗的产品引导); reproduces the four rejected alternatives and the consequence that the Models package now owns product-onboarding presentation.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 6cd139dd (English) and aae20eaf (Chinese).

English agent note: the compact transcript view folds a closed Turn's process rows behind a turn-process disclosure using hidden="until-found" and a beforematch event, without reparenting or unmounting stateful tool renderers.
Chinese translation (Web 轮次过程折叠); reproduces the seven rejected alternatives including the DisclosureRow-unmount option that would break browser find.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob fd7553b3 (English) and a16b4074 (Chinese).

English agent note: web_search takes one required queries array bounded by searchMaxQueries (default 4); multi-query runs concurrently, takes one source at each rank from every query before advancing, and is all-or-nothing on failure.
Chinese translation (web_search 支持一次传入多个查询); reproduces the five rejected alternatives including accepting both query and queries.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 89a3b833 (English) and 31c298ad (Chinese).

English agent note: the System prompt disclosure renders the durable request/header system string as opaque text in the same 141px scrollport the context injection row uses, because Markdown rendering would restyle what the model received.
Chinese translation; the H1 title is kept in English and the section headings stay in English, while the body is Chinese.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob d2963caf (English) and bd7b33bf (Chinese).

Chinese translation (复用崩溃修复的精确事件会话分叉); the section headings stay in English while the body is Chinese.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 17964f7c (English) and d2f89cbd (Chinese).

Chinese translation (会话正文宽度自适应与拖拽调宽); reproduces the four rejected alternatives including the 12px handle strip that shipped first and was unusable.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 9c9487b6 (English) and 4dcbe37e (Chinese).

Chinese translation (模型选择的 subagent 路由); reproduces the eight rejected alternatives including the KV-cache reuse reason for not shipping route selection on forks.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob bc8bee40 (English) and edf114fd (Chinese).

Chinese translation; the H1 title is kept in English and the body preserves the two explicitly deferred items (protocol-crossing compat fields, publish() having no user-visible channel).

Chinese translation (产品 subagent 命名实例); the ownership table is reproduced as a three-column Chinese table.

Chinese translation (Settings 支撑的会话正文字号); reproduces the three rejected alternatives including scaling every font token.
Bilingual pairing record: pins blob 10867474 (English) and 1f742158 (Chinese).

Chinese translation; the H1 title is kept in English and the section headings stay in English while the body is Chinese.
